title: TLS-safe mode process-global side-effect is fully documented in public header
description: The header comment on wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() dedicates ~15 lines to explaining that g_tls_safe_mode is process-global, affects all objects using WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID in the process including those in other libraries, and provides the workaround pattern (register a second devId for bulk-hash use). This level of documentation at the API boundary is the correct approach for a global side effect. A contributor might shorten it to 'sets TLS-safe mode.' The full explanation must be preserved: the process-wide side effect is the most likely source of user confusion and the comment is the only warning they will read before being burned.
